title: querylog.py check scans each distinct value of an ops sidecar once, so a gate that touches the query-log store no longer holds the host lock for minutes
goal: ql_store.leak_problems calls redact.scan once per distinct string value of a store file, whatever the number of rows, and querylog.py check on the committed store finishes in under 60 seconds on this host

run:
import sys,json,tempfile,pathlib as P
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_store,redact
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());f=d/"ops"/"2026-10"/"20261024T000000Z-abcdef12.jsonl";f.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
rows=[{"id":"r%d"%i,"ts":"2026-10-24T00:00:00Z","event":"call.tool","tool":["Bash","Read","Edit","Write","Grep","Glob"][i%6],"state":["ok","error","denied"][i%3]} for i in range(5000)]
f.write_text(json.dumps({"run":f.stem,"counts":{"rows":len(rows)}})+"\n"+"".join(json.dumps(x)+"\n" for x in rows))
n=[0];orig=redact.scan
def counted(v,k=None):
 n[0]+=1;return orig(v,k)
redact.scan=counted
ql_store.leak_problems(d,[f.relative_to(d).as_posix()])
print("redact.scan calls for 5000 rows with 11 distinct values:",n[0])
sys.exit(0 if n[0]<=60 else 1)

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: sync.gate rows 2026-10-16 to 24: 2,746 gates, 726 ran querylog.py check; median 112 s, p90 172 s, max 572 s, 25.2 of 32.7 gate-hours, all under the host main lock (kg_sync.py:1039 runs the whole sync_rounds inside kg_lock.guarded); 42 transcript lines show a push waiting on 'the host main lock held by ... kbgit.py sync --push'. The per-day median grew from 88 s (10-16) to 174 s (10-24) with the store. Direct run today: querylog.py check = 185 s wall, one core, problems=0. cProfile of ql_store.store_problems: 198 s, ops_sidecar_problems 187 s, leak_problems 184 s, redact.scan called 1,438,233 times (153 s own time), each call also stats the pointer-file directories (kbcommon._pointer_files, _private_patterns: 1.44M isdir calls). ql_deliver.py:672 runs the same check again before the sync that runs it a second time. land.step kbgit.py-sync-push: 156 of 1,162 steps took over 60 s (6.1 h). Saves about 25 of the 33 hours of sync-gate time a week (77%), roughly 3 minutes per gate that touches the store. Also in the item's scope, not read by the repro: the gate and the delivery's bring() run the store check once per delivery, not twice, and redact.scan does not stat the private-pattern directories on every call (cache them per process); a planted run file is cheap, a timing on the committed store is host-load dependent.
